description:
Assign a user-flair template as a member's worn flair. The colony
    must have user flair enabled and the target must be a member.
    Requires ``can_manage_flair`` authority. Writes a ModLog row.

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

template_id.description: The user-flair template id (UUID) to assign as their worn flair
template_id.title: Template Id

username.description: The member to assign the flair to: a username or a user ID
username.title: Username

name: colony_assign_user_flair
